# Dynamical Systems

This course covers ODEs, phase portraits, bifurcations, stability analysis, limit cycles, and chaotic systems.

When computing course math, use NumPy/SciPy for:
- Eigenvalues, determinants, matrix exponentials
- ODE/IVP integration, phase portraits, trajectories
- Fixed points, Jacobians, linearization numerically

The `lecture-notes` skill (`shared/.github/skills/lecture-notes/SKILL.md`) has the full workflow for reading handwritten lecture notes.
